items.title: How we saved 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1’s DNS cache
items.blurb: Five Rust-level memory optimizations to the DNS cache layout of Big Pineapple cut per-entry memory by 56%, freeing approximately 100 TB of memory across Cloudflare's fleet.

Understanding Go's sync.Map from API to Hash Trie
items.blurb: Go’s sync.Map now uses a hash trie. This article builds the implementation from a normal map, then explains lock-free reads, fine-grained writer locking, collisions, retries, deletion, Clear, Range, and the trade-offs against map plus…

items.title: Hunting Down a Go Runtime Bug on 32-bit Embedded Systems
items.blurb: A customer's Go application kept crashing on a 32-bit embedded Linux system. We traced the fatal netpoll error to a pointer aliasing bug in the Go runtime.
